title: Korean Tteok Pancake with Hazelnut Jam
description: A unique dessert recipe that combines Korean tteok with hazelnut jam, perfect for a sweet treat. The crunchy texture of the tteok pairs well with the sweet and nutty flavor of the hazelnut jam.
instructions: Soak the tteok in jolted milk for at least 30 minutes.
Drain the tteok and cut it into small pieces.
Heat a non-stick pan over medium heat.
Add the tteok pieces to the pan and cook for 2-3 minutes on each side.
Serve the cooked tteok with hazelnut jam.
Optional: Sprinkle Korean red pepper flakes on top of the tteok for added spice.
